batch.description: University of Chittagong (CU) A Unit question-bank collection — 2016-2017. 98 questions (Bangla 10, English 15, Physics 24, Chemistry 25, Higher Mathematics 24). Answer status: 64 verified / 34 unverified; this reflects answer-key review status, not an assertion that the question text is flawless. Import QA 2026-11-19: 22 subject labels corrected; cross-batch source IDs made importer-safe; source-conflicted keys remain unverified. This is a historical question-bank collection, not a claim that the pack count equals the official exam quota. the rest carry their best single-source key or no key, flagged per question. Explanations are null throughout (no cleanly alignable source). No Biology section exists in any available source for this session (S1 transcription, Chorcha and the book grid all lack it). The book grid failed position-alignment validation for this session and was not used. 2 source-defect question(s) excluded (stem or options exist only as images in the source transcription; listed in the collection audit report). AI-solved keys (2026-11-18, not source-verified): 27. Keyless: 3. QA audit 2026-11-19: see QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
